jurisdictionScope.default: General executive curriculum using fictional organizations. Switzerland and EU are separate applicability investigations; neither location nor framework alignment establishes a legal obligation.
jurisdictionScope.switzerland: Determine federal/private/cantonal context, sector, authority, data flows and applicable text. FDPIC overview checked; Fedlex text unavailable in this check. Canton and industry remain unresolved.
jurisdictionScope.eu: Determine entity, establishment, territorial nexus, sector/size, regulated role and processing/AI use. Check GDPR, NIS2 national implementation, DORA sector scope, AI Act phased provisions and the applicable consolidated texts before legal teaching.
jurisdictionScope.publicationGate: Legal text remains unverified due to access challenges. No article, reporting deadline or definitive applicability conclusion is authored here; qualified jurisdiction-specific review required.
